newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Turnover down on Bucharest bourse.
newsitem.headline: Turnover down on Bucharest bourse.

text.p: Turnover on the Bucharest bourse slipped to 25.46 million lei from 27.38 million in the previous session, in light trading on Tuesday when the VAB unofficial index fell to an all-time low of 285.1 points.
Some 4,971 shares changed hands on Tuesday, when six stocks inched up, two drifted down, four marked time and two had no trade.

Newcomer Uztel SA oilfield equipment maker, which performed poorly in the last session on Thursday, gained 1,050 lei, to close at 5,050. Impact Bucuresti SA construction company inched up to 13,900 lei from 12,700.
Buyers' interest remained focused on Azomures SA fertiliser maker, which took almost 52 percent of the turnover but closed unchanged at 11,000 lei.
Syringe maker Sanevit SA remained suspended for the fifth session in a row pending an announcement.
The exchange expects 10 more companies to come to trading before year's end.

The unofficial value-weighted VAB index, computed by Vanguard SA securities, fell by 3.1 percent from the previous session to 285.1 points while the Bucharest Investment Group's BIG index rose by 0.035 percent but showed a 1.03 percent fall over the past week.
